summary: For the visual design lead, Lucid improved clearly. The worst bilingual problem (Hebrew glosses repeating English sentences) is gone. Lesson feedback is now a calm, content-width footer with an accent bar. The essay checks stay beside the text at desktop, and Today, welcome, writing-lab cards, vocab rows and the 150% app chrome are clean. Of 17 earlier findings, 8 are fixed and 9 partly; nothing regressed. The weakest area is still bilingual alignment. English paragraphs are right-aligned (ragged start) on Hebrew-led A1 screens and left-aligned on English-led B2 screens, and in B2 intros and instructions one-line and two-line items still flip in the same card. Next weakest are the components the plan missed: the Settings segmented control collides at 150%, word-game feedback is still pink and red, native checkboxes and radios remain in games and the essay editor, dark segmented controls barely show their selected state, and the reading hub is an 8,198px list.

new_findings.title: Settings 'הסברים בעברית' segmented labels collide at 150%
new_findings.problem: At 390 and 150% the five-segment control renders 'חלקי בלחיצהכבוי': 'בלחיצה' and 'כבוי' overlap and cannot be read. At 100% 'לפי הרמה' wraps to two lines while the others stay on one.
new_findings.suggestion: Render as a radio-card list below about 30rem or when the labels don't fit, or as an equal-cell grid like the Today minutes control. Never let segment labels shrink below their content.

new_findings.title: Multi-line English right-aligned (ragged start) on Hebrew-led screens
new_findings.problem: English can-dos and hints of 2-4 lines are text-align:right at A1 and A2 (line starts at x=60, 60, 205), while the same kind of text is left-aligned at B2. LTR lines should share a start edge.
new_findings.evidence: Alignment dump: A1 intro ta:right with lastLineLeft 205-236; B2 intro ta:start. shots/L0-a1-03-390-light.png, L0-a1-03-1440-light.png, crop-path390.png
new_findings.suggestion: Only guaranteed one-line labels share the Hebrew edge. Any English that can wrap is a left-aligned LTR block, chosen by the text's role, not by whether it fits.

new_findings.title: Today 'done' items fade below AA contrast
new_findings.problem: .plan-item.done { opacity: 0.6 } (css line 327) takes the done item's English can-do and Hebrew note to about 2.9:1.
new_findings.evidence: Set 10 min, finished the lesson part, back to Today at 390 light. Pixel (144,149,154) on (248,250,252). shots/done-today-after-full.png
new_findings.suggestion: Remove the opacity. Mark done with the green check glyph and --ink-2/--ink-3 text colours.

new_findings.title: Sort exercise with sentence items is cramped at 390; answer list doubles punctuation
new_findings.problem: Two 160px bins hold centred sentences wrapping to 5-6 lines. The shown answer joins items as 'trip., If he hadn't...' and the footer fills about half the screen.
new_findings.evidence: 390 dark, sort item, 'לא יודע/ת'. shots/P1c-b2-02-390-dark.png (in sheet-b2-dark.png)
new_findings.suggestion: Stack the bins at full width with left-aligned items when items are long or the viewport is under 30rem. Render the answer as list items without commas.

new_findings.title: Desktop sidebar at 1440x900 hides five destinations with no cue
new_findings.problem: The deck nav has 13 items in a 608px scroll area (scrollHeight 866). 'מרכז האזנה' is cut at the edge, and speaking, writing, tutor and expressions are hidden without any scroll affordance.
new_findings.suggestion: Tighten the item height, group the labs under a collapsible heading, or at least add a fade at the bottom edge.

new_findings.title: Dark-mode segmented controls barely show the selected state
new_findings.problem: The selected segment (26,31,36) on the track (18,22,27) is 1.09:1 with no edge, so only the bolder weight signals the selection.
new_findings.suggestion: Add a --key-edge border and skirt, or a lighter fill, to reach 3:1 as a non-text indicator.

new_findings.title: Segmented controls wrap into ragged grids
new_findings.problem: In vocab, '0 ידועות' drops alone to a second row. Conversations puts 9 categories in 3 rows in one track, with a half-width level control under it. 'לא רשמי מאוד' wraps in the expressions sheet.
new_findings.suggestion: Use at most 3-4 short segments. Use scrolling chips or a select for categories, and 2x2 cells for the vocab filters.

new_findings.title: Two selected-card styles in onboarding step 2
new_findings.problem: A chosen goal card is blue-tinted, while the chosen minutes card is grey-tinted.
new_findings.suggestion: Use one selected treatment (tint plus indicator) for all choice cards.

new_findings.title: Player header and footer differ across lesson, review, game and scenario
new_findings.problem: The counter sits centred under the bar in lessons and inline at the left in review. The scenario practice uses a small grey 'בדיקה' key at the far left instead of the full-width orange footer key.
new_findings.suggestion: One player-top component and one footer layout for every check-then-continue flow.

new_findings.title: 'לא עכשיו' looks heavier than the action next to it
new_findings.problem: The secondary 'לא עכשיו'/'Not now' has a grey fill and dark border, so it looks pressed. The add-A1-words action is a plain white key.
new_findings.suggestion: Make 'לא עכשיו' a ghost or text button.

new_findings.title: Essay editor: orphan level chip, repeated 'בעברית' chips, English category tags
new_findings.problem: A lone 'B2' chip floats above the side panel. 8+ identical 'בעברית' chips appear on the prompt, topics and requirements. The connector categories show in English ('addition', 'contrast') in the Hebrew UI. The topic list uses native radios.
new_findings.suggestion: Move the chip into the meta line, use one 'הכול בעברית' toggle, and use Hebrew category labels.

new_findings.title: Games hub at desktop: stage keys float mid-row; memory backs are loud
new_findings.problem: The 1-2-3 stage keys sit at x 660-808 in 1,088px rows. The memory card backs are a dense blue hatch, the busiest surface in the games.
new_findings.suggestion: Pin the keys to the inline-end or cap the row width. Give the card backs a quiet keycap surface.

new_findings.title: Practice labs grid: uneven tiles and over-wide recommended cards
new_findings.problem: In the 2-column grid, the 'משחקי מילים' tile is 104px tall next to a 78px 'אוצר מילים'. The 'מומלץ עכשיו' cards are 1,088px wide with the chevron about 1,000px from the text.
new_findings.suggestion: Stretch the rows to equal height, and cap the recommended cards at the content measure or put them two across.

summary: For a UX researcher looking at first run and navigation, the new build is clearly better. Today can now say "התוכנית להיום הושלמה", and extra items sit under an optional "רוצים עוד?". Pre-A1 lesson 1 leads with Hebrew and teaches in 5 short learn steps. Placement shows "שאלה N מתוך כ-20" and offers the same level-named escapes on every screen. Settings and Help stay visible on the desktop rail, and leaving a lesson returns to the screen you came from. Of my 18 earlier findings, 12 are fixed and 6 partly fixed, with none regressed. The weakest point is that the screens still disagree about what "done" means. The lesson end's primary, "להמשיך בתוכנית: חזרה", lands on a Today that says the plan is complete and lists that review as optional. Minute figures also shift between visits, and after a weak score the return intro falls back to drilling the mistakes instead of re-learning.

new_findings.title: 'Continue the plan' on the lesson end leads to a Today that says the plan is done
new_findings.problem: The lesson-end primary promises the plan continues with a review, but it only opens Today, which says the plan is complete and lists that review as optional.
new_findings.evidence: Lesson end primary 'להמשיך בתוכנית: חזרה על מילים · 2 דק׳' (r5-04b-complete-long.png). After tapping it the URL was #/today, headed 'התוכנית להיום הושלמה (כ-24 דק׳)', with '8 מילים חדשות: סבב ראשון' under 'רוצים עוד? לא חובה' (r5-06-today-after.png).
new_findings.suggestion: Use one done rule on both screens. If the minutes are met, make the primary 'סיימתם להיום · לתוכנית' and the review a secondary that opens #/review directly. If the plan continues, make the button open the item it names.
new_findings.affects: Every learner who finishes a whole lesson

new_findings.title: After a weak lesson, the return intro drops the re-learn-first advice
new_findings.problem: The end screen recommends re-reading the explanation first, but on return the orange key is the mistakes drill, and re-reading is a grey button in the banner.
new_findings.evidence: r9-03-end-weak.png primary 'לקרוא שוב את ההסבר ואז לתרגל'; r9-02-intro-return.png primary 'לתרגל את 13 הטעויות · כ-17 דק׳', secondary 'לקרוא שוב את ההסבר קודם'; Today: 'תיקון הטעויות יכול להשלים את השיעור' (r9-01)
new_findings.suggestion: Below 50%, keep the same primary on the return intro and suggest re-learning in the Today line.

new_findings.title: At Pre-A1 the chosen goal never appears, though onboarding promises it as a suggestion
new_findings.problem: Onboarding says 'ב-10 דקות: שיעור וחזרה. המטרות מופיעות כהצעה'. A1 travel learners get 'יש עוד 4 דקות? <scenario>', but Pre-A1 learners get nothing travel-related; scenarios.json has no Pre-A1 scenario.
new_findings.evidence: r10-today-10min-travel-PreA1.png (no goal line) vs r10-today-10min-travel-A1.png ('יש עוד 4 דקות? Finding your gate for a connecting flight'); r1-15b after the lesson: only the lesson rest and a word game
new_findings.suggestion: Offer a goal-matched expressions set or one A1 travel scenario marked 'אתגר קטן' at Pre-A1, or say in onboarding that goals join the plan from A1.
new_findings.affects: Zero-level learners with a travel or work goal

new_findings.title: Minutes for the same finished lesson change between visits
new_findings.problem: Today's time figures drift, which undermines trust in 'done (כ-N דק׳)'.
new_findings.evidence: The finished a2-01 row showed '14 דק׳' (r5-06) and later '10 דק׳' (r6-05). The headline went from 24 to 25 after a 2-minute review. The run 1 part was announced as 'כ-10 דקות' but the done headline said 'כ-6 דק׳' (r1-14b, r1-15b).
new_findings.suggestion: Freeze a finished item's minutes when it is done, and make the headline their sum, using one estimate everywhere.

new_findings.title: The review end says missed words return 'בעוד דקה' while Today marks the review done
new_findings.problem: Mixed messages about when to come back. The 'לשחק במילים האלה' key is below the fold.
new_findings.evidence: r6-04-review-end.png: 7 rows 'תחזור בעוד דקה'; r6-05: 'חזרה מרווחת · 8 מילים · עברתם היום על 8 מילים' ticked, with no follow-up item

new_findings.suggestion: Keep the round for the session and offer 'להמשיך משאלה 3 מתוך 10' / 'סיבוב חדש' on return.

new_findings.title: A saved scenario is only visible inside the 'תרגול' tab
new_findings.problem: With 2 of 5 turns saved, Today and the hub show the scenario as new, and opening it lands on 'הכנה' with no hint; the resume offer appears only after tapping 'תרגול'.
new_findings.suggestion: Open on 'תרגול' when a place is saved, or show 'עצרתם בתור 3 מתוך 5 · להמשיך' above the tabs; give the hub card an in-progress ring like the Path.

new_findings.title: The learn step I was on is not remembered
new_findings.problem: Leaving at 'שלב 3 מתוך 4' and reopening shows the intro with 'בואו נלמד' and starts reading from step 1, though the plan (LF-2) says to save the current step.
new_findings.suggestion: When left during learn, make the intro's primary key 'להמשיך לקרוא · שלב 3 מתוך 4'.

new_findings.title: Hebrew explanations in scenario feedback are 11.4 px
new_findings.problem: The Hebrew line under each English explanation (.bi-he) computes to 11.44px in blue on dark grey, smaller than the 13-15px English it translates, and it's the line an A2 learner actually reads.
new_findings.suggestion: Make feedback Hebrew at least 14px at 100% text, never smaller than its English.
new_findings.affects: A2 learners, tired or low-vision readers, dark mode at night

new_findings.title: Today's 'done' minutes don't match the plan
new_findings.problem: Plan and part-end say 'כ-10 דקות'; Today's headline then says 'התוכנית להיום הושלמה (כ-5 דק׳)', and later grows to 'כ-30 דק׳' as games are counted; the lesson card switches from 10 to 9 דק׳.
new_findings.suggestion: Count the reading time too, or state what was done without a minutes figure.

new_findings.title: After the day's travel scenario, 'רוצים עוד?' stops offering travel
new_findings.problem: After check-in, hotel and restaurant, the extras list review, lesson and word game but no travel item, though the hub still recommends 'Passport control and customs on arrival' at my level.
new_findings.suggestion: Show the hub's next 'כדאי להתחיל כאן' item in the extras once the first is done.

new_findings.title: Practice and games still use some older pressure and copy
new_findings.problem: In calm mode the picture game still says 'וטעות מורידה 3' while memory has no slip penalty; the practice hub keeps 'מילים שבדיוק לפני שכחה'; the speed switch is a native 13x13 checkbox that is hard to see in dark mode.
new_findings.suggestion: No minus points in calm mode for both picture games, reuse Today's review copy, use the 24px app checkbox.

new_findings.title: The word quiz checks on tap, everything else checks with 'בדיקה'
new_findings.problem: 'הבחירה נבדקת מיד' — a mis-tap counts as wrong at once, while lessons, scenarios and review now select then check.
new_findings.suggestion: Keep it honest as now, but consider confirm-on-second-tap or select-then-check in calm mode.

new_findings.title: 'Level 2: home, city and travel' opened on a food board
new_findings.problem: Board 1 of 3 was broccoli, fried egg, popcorn, croissant and coins: nothing about travel in a level named for it.
new_findings.suggestion: Mix boards so each has an item from the theme, or rename the level.

summary: As Rina (A1 false beginner, 390px touch phone, Hebrew UI, 115%, dark mode at night), the app now feels clearly built for me. Text size comes on the first onboarding screen. There is no AI consent form. Hebrew leads the explanations, which are split into 5 short steps. Pitfall boxes start with the mouth and have play buttons. Matching forgives one slip in amber. Second tries let me fix mistakes myself. The lesson-end box talks about my own mistakes. Review nights still move the lesson 4 exercises forward. Today can say the plan is done, and the picture game waits for me. 14 of 17 earlier findings are fixed and 3 are partly fixed. The weakest points now: the speaking self-mark is no longer acknowledged ('נרשם: צריך עוד תרגול' is gone). The lesson end repeats whole paragraphs and does not credit mistakes I fixed myself. It also disagrees with Today about whether I am done. IPA still leads the in-lesson speaking tip and the speaking lab's pair menu, and the 'next listening' item still comes from an unstarted lesson.

new_findings.title: Marking 'צריך עוד תרגול' in a lesson is no longer acknowledged
new_findings.problem: After tapping 'צריך עוד תרגול' and then 'המשך', the lesson jumps straight to exercise 15. The neutral verdict 'נרשם: צריך עוד תרגול' that made speaking feel safe no longer appears; only a thin outline on the tapped button shows the choice.
new_findings.evidence: 60-speak-selfmarked.png, then the footer after 'המשך' reads 'שמירה ובדיקה · עוד 10 מילים', '15 מתוך 15' (61-speak-after-continue.png)

new_findings.affects: Anxious beginners who rely on reassurance in speaking

new_findings.title: Lesson-end box repeats a whole paragraph for a one-word gap mistake
new_findings.problem: For the 'plays' gap mistake, 'כדאי לשים לב' shows the whole Noa message struck through and then the whole corrected message, about 10 lines, to show one changed word.
new_findings.suggestion: For gap exercises, show only the gap sentence or the word ('we ~~plays~~ → we play'). Keep the full sentence for short transform and correct items.

new_findings.title: A mistake fixed on the second try is listed as a plain mistake
new_findings.problem: I fixed 'My brother and I is work in a shop.' myself after the hint 'מי הנושא? שני אנשים.', but the end box lists it as 'כתבתם: ... →' with no credit.
new_findings.suggestion: Mark such items 'תיקנתם בעצמכם' with a check icon.

new_findings.title: Writing task shows two different word minimums
new_findings.problem: Under the empty box: '0 מילים · לפחות 25'. On the disabled key: 'שמירה ובדיקה · עוד 10 מילים'. After writing, the checks say 'יעד 25-80'.
new_findings.suggestion: Use one number, or label them clearly ('עוד 10 מילים לשמירה' / 'יעד: 25-80 מילים').

new_findings.title: First pitfall in lesson 1 is about 'agree', a word the lesson never teaches
new_findings.problem: The first 'מלכודת לדוברי עברית' box is 'agree הוא פועל ... I agree – בלי am', with play buttons for agree and I agree. 'agree' is not in the lesson's words or exercises. The rule in the lesson's own verbs comes two steps later.
new_findings.suggestion: Lead step 1's pitfall with the lesson's verbs ('I work, לא I am work'), and keep 'I agree' as an extra example.

new_findings.title: Lesson end and Today disagree about whether tonight's plan is done
new_findings.problem: The lesson-end main key says 'להמשיך בתוכנית: חזרה על מילים · 2 דק׳', but Today says 'התוכנית להיום הושלמה (כ-24 דק׳)' and lists the same review as optional under 'רוצים עוד?'. The done lesson card shows '8 דק׳' for a 20-minute lesson.
new_findings.suggestion: When Today counts the plan as done, the lesson-end key should say 'סיימתם להיום' or offer the review as optional. Show the real lesson time.
new_findings.affects: Learners who study once a night

new_findings.title: Trailing full stop jumps to the front of short English examples
new_findings.problem: '... ועובדות: I work in a bank.' shows its second line as '.I work in a bank', and the a1-02 objective ends with '.lives, watches'.
new_findings.suggestion: When a Hebrew sentence ends with an English example, keep the final full stop inside the English isolate.

new_findings.title: 'תחזור בעוד דקה' on the review done screen
new_findings.problem: Each missed word says 'תחזור בעוד דקה' at 22:30, as if I should stay and wait, yet Today 40 minutes later did not bring the words back.
new_findings.suggestion: Say 'תחזור בחזרה הבאה' or 'מחר' instead of exact minutes.

new_findings.title: Words and pictures still takes 3 points per wrong pair in calm mode
new_findings.problem: A wrong pair shows 'לא מתאים. נסו שוב. (פחות 3 נקודות)', and the hub says 'טעות מורידה 3', although calm mode is on and the memory game's description mentions no penalty.
new_findings.suggestion: In calm mode, drop the penalty and show accuracy. Keep −3 for 'אתגר מהירות'.

new_findings.title: Red wavy underline of the original sentence touches the answer box
new_findings.problem: The wavy line under 'a shop.' sits on the textarea's top border.
new_findings.suggestion: Add about 12px between the sentence and the textarea.

new_findings.title: Listening items can be answered with no English voice, unlike the speaking lab
new_findings.problem: With no English voice, the speaking lab shows a banner and locks its answers, but the listening item let me choose an option and get 'נכון' with no warning. There is also no 'לא יודע/ת' option.
new_findings.suggestion: Reuse the speaking lab's no-voice banner and lock in listening items, and add 'לא יודע/ת'.

summary: For Hana (68, Pre-A1, 150% text, large phone) the experience is much better. She can enlarge the text on the Welcome screen and in onboarding step 1, and lesson 1 opens at 150%. The alphabet table fits the screen, gives every letter a play button and hides IPA. The progress bar stays visible. The games no longer rush her or pay for speed. Review now selects, then checks. Typed slips get a kind second try or "כמעט!". Help explains what to do when nothing plays and how to practise speaking without a microphone. Weakest now: lesson 2's sound content. The th/w/v and ship/sheep table has no play buttons, the IPA toggle does not hide the IPA in the vowel cards, and a wrong sound answer is explained only in IPA. At 150% the listening options and categorize bins still start below the fold. When no voice is available, the toast covers "לאט" and the transcript only appears after she has answered.

summary: For an adult Hebrew-speaking beginner, the new build is clearly better. Pre-A1 now leads with Hebrew. The learn stage comes in short steps, with a "מלכודת לדוברי עברית" box next to the rule and play chips for the word pairs. Find-and-fix items give a targeted note and a second try before the answer, and end with a word diff. Scenario own-words replies now flag "I am agree", "Nice to know you", "explain me" and missing articles. Review options are fair, and games no longer pressure. Still weakest: targeted drills give less help than lessons (no primer, no second try, no pitfall, and a word-order grab-bag with untaught grammar). Lesson listening items are still scored when no voice plays. A1 rule tables explain the rule in English only. A few second-try notes misdiagnose what the learner actually wrote.

new_findings.title: Targeted drills have no second try, no pitfall and no primer

new_findings.title: Second-try note for th assumes s when the learner wrote t
new_findings.problem: 'I tink so, tanks!' got 'בשתי מילים צריך th במקום s.', and the final 'why' talks about 'I sink'. t-substitution is the other common Hebrew pattern, and the lesson's own pitfall names it ('טינק').
new_findings.suggestion: Add a wrong_feedback pattern for tink/tanks ('כתבתם t; ב-th הלשון בין השיניים'), or make the note neutral ('בשתי מילים צריך th').

new_findings.title: Generic second-try note, then a 'why' about the part already fixed

summary: For an EAP lecturer the writing lab has changed in kind. With AI off it now teaches: there is a rubric tab with Band 5/3/1 descriptors, self-rating saved per version, and "final (self-assessed)" kept apart from the writing level. Source-use checks list cited and uncited sources against the pack and name verbatim overlaps (A/B/C) while leaving quoted text alone. Structure ticks show the phrase they matched. The checks now catch most of the Hebrew-L1 errors the C1/C2 lessons teach, and from stage 8 they highlight sweeping claims. Sources, plans and checklists read left to right on desktop, phone and dark mode, and the checks panel stays in view at 1440. What is still weakest: the deferred items (no university genres or bring-your-own-assignment, no export of an essay with its versions, repeated topics). Lesson writing tasks are still one-shot, read-only, with mismatched ranges and RTL check cards, and never reach the lab. A few judgment gaps remain: a draft can be marked final at half the minimum, bare "research" or "survey" ticks evidence, and the sweeping-word and overlap highlighters have predictable false positives. Report: /home/user/desktop-tutorial/lucid/docs/qa/panels-r3-retest/teacher-academic.md

summary: On a phone, the core practice loop now behaves as one system. Lessons, review and scenario practice all select first and commit with "בדיקה". Selected states are visible everywhere, secondary keys look like keys, keyboard hints are gone on touch, and the verdict footer is calm (neutral surface, accent bar, ✓/✗ on the options). The games no longer hurry the learner, and matching and the essay editor behave well. The weakest area is still large text: at 150% a wrong verdict takes 49% of the screen, and the new second-try footer takes 59% and cuts the hint mid-sentence with no scroll cue. Smaller gaps remain in the games and the scenario: the picture game's in-card "ללוח הבא" key, the old pink game verdict cards, and a scenario footer that floats 64 px above the tab bar from turn 2. A few sub-44 px links and a 13 px checkbox are also left.

summary: For a keyboard and screen-reader learner, the experience changed a lot. Every exercise now opens with focus on its prompt, and focus moves to the next sensible control after each action. Enter always checks or continues, match and memory announce their results, the option groups in onboarding and Settings have names, and the games no longer rush anyone. 10 of my 13 earlier findings are fixed, 3 are partly fixed, and none regressed. The weakest point now is the new word-bank target gap. Tabbing through the gaps to reach the chips makes the last gap the target, so a keyboard user's first word lands in the wrong gap, and with no second try the item is lost. Next come first-try hints that give away the full answer in English, and Settings' segmented controls overlapping at 150%. new_findings.title: Tabbing to the word bank moves the target to the last gap, so the first word lands in the wrong place
new_findings.route: #/lesson/a1-01 (gap with word bank, 'השלימו את ההודעה של נועה')
new_findings.problem: The target gap follows focus. A keyboard user must Tab through gap 1, 2 and 3 to reach the chips, so the target silently becomes gap 3, and the first chip (the right word for gap 1) goes into gap 3. The verdict is wrong with no second try, because a word-bank gap counts as a choice. Chips do not say which gap they will fill. WCAG 3.2.1, 2.4.3, 4.1.2.
new_findings.evidence: r08b.mjs: after Tab x5 to 'live' and Enter, the values are ['', '', 'live']; r08b-before-live.png shows the target outline on gap 3; 07-a1-01.log step 5: chips live, study, play chosen in order, verdict 'לא בדיוק'.
new_findings.suggestion: Move the target only when the learner activates a gap (Enter, Space, click or typing), not when focus passes through it. Default to the first empty gap. Add aria-describedby on the chips ('ייכנס למילה חסרה 1'). Add the 'Tab to the first chip, Enter' path to the e2e suite.

new_findings.title: The first-try 'fix it yourself' hint gives away the full answer in English

The second try only means copying it, and the two languages repeat each other (cognitive load).
new_findings.suggestion: First-try hints: the rule only, in the support language. Add a validator rule that wrong_feedback shown before a retry must not contain any accepted answer.
new_findings.affects: All learners, especially those with attention or reading difficulties

new_findings.title: At 150% text, Settings' segmented controls overflow and overlap
new_findings.problem: 'הסברים בעברית' gives each of its 5 buttons 50px, but the text needs 58-82px: 'בלחיצה' and 'כבוי' run together ('בלחיצכבוי'), and 'לפי הרמה' breaks. 'לפי המכשיר', 'בינלאומית' and 'אמריקאית' also overflow. This is in the new 'תמיכה בלמידה' section. WCAG 1.4.4, 1.4.10.
new_findings.suggestion: Let .seg wrap into a 2-column grid (as 'גודל טקסט' already does) or stack it when the labels don't fit. Add the overflow check to the 150% e2e.
new_findings.affects: Low-vision learners using 130-150% text on phones

liked: The lesson player now has one focus contract: the prompt h2 on mount, focus moved after every pick, and Enter that always checks or continues (Ctrl+Enter on typed items).
Calm pace by default: nothing in the three games moved on by itself in 6s, memory cards stay up, and speed is an explicit opt-in 'אתגר מהירות'.
Text size can be chosen in step 1 of onboarding and applies at once; the onboarding radios follow the ARIA radio pattern with roving tabindex and arrow keys.
Match and memory now announce results in polite live lines; match columns are named groups and the finished board is a list of pairs with named play buttons.
Settings has 13 labelled groups, keeps focus on the pressed option, and gathers learning support in 'תמיכה בלמידה' with 'קצב רגוע' on by default.
Review selects, then checks, with varied answer positions and distractors, and its empty state has an h1 and an action.
Reduced motion still gives zero running animations on every screen I tested, including the new learn steps, part end and Today; contrast passes in both themes apart from the faded Today card.
Onboarding errors focus the invalid field, set aria-invalid and link the message with aria-describedby; the AI consent is gone from this AI-off site.

summary: For Lior (16, Bagrut, phone, 10-minute bursts), Lucid now has fewer rough edges. Enter keycaps, AI consent, the English-UI banner and rulebook-style game rules are gone. Today can say the plan is done and offers a B1 game under "רוצים עוד?". The review checks only after the learner selects, and its end screen sends missed words straight into the word quiz. Matching forgives a slip, "הכול בעברית" is one tap and is remembered, and picture and memory games open at level 3. The weakest points are still the Bagrut and the 10-minute day. Outside Onboarding and the optional reading line on Today, the Bagrut goal is invisible: 0 mentions on Reading, Writing, Help and Real life. A 10-minute day is still about 7 minutes of explanation reading (6 steps, each 1.4 to 2.2 screens) before 4 exercises. Typed-answer feedback still has holes: "Have you ever went to Eilat?" can still be self-credited, and the end-of-lesson note explains word order instead of the participle error.

new_findings.title: Lesson-end note explains the wrong rule for my mistake
new_findings.problem: For 'Have you ever went to Eilat?' (right word order, wrong participle) the end screen shows e11's fixed word-order explanation: 'In a question, have/has comes before the subject' / 'בשאלה have/has בא לפני הנושא'. It never names went vs been. b1-01.json e11 has one explanation with error_type word-order, and it is shown for any wrong answer.
new_findings.evidence: Typed the answer on e11, finished the lesson, read the end screen: 18-lesson-end.png. Checked content/lessons/b1-01.json e11.
new_findings.suggestion: Choose the note from the diff. If the learner's word order matches the key and only the verb differs, show a participle note ('אחרי have בא past participle: been, לא went'). Keep the word-order note for answers that still start 'You have'.
new_findings.affects: Every learner who makes a different error than the one the exercise anticipates

new_findings.title: Self-credit still offered for the lesson's target error (went for been)
new_findings.problem: 'Have you ever went to Eilat?' gets amber 'לא אחת מהתשובות שלנו' and the button 'גם התשובה שלי נכונה', although the key's verb form 'been' is missing. One tap counts it as correct.
new_findings.suggestion: Treat went/gone-for-been and did+V-ed as known wrong forms in present-perfect rewrites. Give a red verdict with a second try, and offer self-credit only when the key's main verb form is present.
new_findings.affects: B1 learners, and any teen looking for a shortcut

summary: Lucid now treats Omer, a B2 learner, much more honestly. Coming back to a lesson resumes it, and a restart keeps his first tries, so the score was a true 84%. Typed answers get a second try with a note aimed at Hebrew speakers. Progress shows the evidence ('Collecting evidence: 11 answers at B2, 80% right · day 1 of 2', plus the level check in the skill rows). The B2 work scenarios now catch until/by, 'I will be happy if' and 'I am agree', with a goal checklist per turn. Email mode checks the greeting, the request and the sign-off, and no longer sets a word minimum. The weakest parts are the two deferred items that matter most to this learner: nothing trains speaking on the spot, and there is no work-writing strand. summary: For a Bagrut teacher, the new build fixes the feedback layer more than the curriculum. There is now a real second try on typed answers. True/False shows what the student chose, and a 5/6 reading reads "5 מתוך 6 נכונות". The writing check caught 12 of the 14 errors in my test text, the B1 Hebrew comes back with one "הכול בעברית" switch, the level-check results show what the student wrote, the games are calm, and listening opens at the student's level. Seven earlier findings are fixed and six partly, but the fix-it-yourself loop is still not honest. In all five second tries I saw, the note gave the answer away. On b1-02 e11 the generic "did live, not did lived" hint led to "I did live in Tel Aviv since 2020.", which was offered self-credit, and the lesson ended at 99%. "I have know" is graded as a spelling slip and counted right. The A2 lesson writing check missed goed/eated/buyed/sleeped, the lesson's own targets. The level checks still have no reading text and reuse lesson items, and the reading questions are still closed-only (the Bagrut track was deferred in the plan).

new_findings.title: The second-try hint leads to another wrong sentence that can then be self-credited

Following it ('I did live in Tel Aviv since 2020.') brings the amber 'גם התשובה שלי נכונה' button, and pressing it ends the lesson at 99%. The self-credit check also passes 'I lived/I am living/I have live/I have been lived … since 2020' and 'Maya have just passed'.

new_findings.title: The fix-it-yourself note usually contains the answer
new_findings.problem: The note shown on the first miss includes the corrected form ('leave → left'; 'gets up → got up, has → had'; 'say I went by bus'; 'has just passed'; 'I've known Noa for ten years'), so the second try is copying.
new_findings.evidence: a2-05-ex-07-e8-TRY1.png, a2-05-ex-09-e10-TRY1.png, a2-05-log.txt, b1-02-log.txt (5 of the 5 second tries I saw)

new_findings.affects: All learners; it undermines the main pedagogical change of this round

new_findings.title: A missing past participle is graded as a spelling slip and counted right

new_findings.affects: B1-B2 learners working on the present perfect and the passive

new_findings.title: The lesson writing check misses the lesson's own target errors
new_findings.problem: A text with goed, eated, buyed, sleeped, 'we was', 'we see' (for the past) and 'a new shoes' got only one flag, 'a amazing', even though the checklist below it warns 'לא goed ולא buyed'.

new_findings.affects: A1-B1 learners; with AI off it is the only writing feedback in lessons

new_findings.title: Fixing a mistake yourself earns nothing and is not acknowledged

new_findings.affects: Learners who self-correct, who are the ones the feature is for

new_findings.title: Paragraph numbers count salutations, signatures and headings

summary: For a learner with dyslexia, ADHD or slow processing, Lucid is now much calmer and kinder. Hebrew leads at Pre-A1/A1, with the English folded behind 'EN'. Typed answers get a shame-free second try. Matching forgives one slip and ends with the pairs side by side. All three games wait for the learner, with no speed bonus by default. Review selects first and checks after. The progress bar survives 150%, and resume puts the learner back on the same exercise. Of my 19 earlier findings, 10 are fixed and 9 partly fixed, with no regressions. The weakest areas now: at large text, the Hebrew-explanations control in Settings is unreadable at 130–150%, and learn steps run to 2.5 screens each. The memory game still gates level 2 on working-memory 'accuracy' and shows a slip tally. Wrong or misspelled forms are still sometimes shown in green or lower case: the 'evrey' field, and the capitals task answer.

new_findings.title: An 'almost' misspelling stays in a green field
new_findings.problem: 'evrey' is marked green on the first check and stays green after 'המילה נכונה; האיות: every'; no amber letter marks.
new_findings.evidence: Typed 'evrey … in' at 130%, used the second try; 26-a1-gap-second-130.png.
new_findings.suggestion: Show 'almost' words in amber with the differing letters marked, and show 'evrey → every' after the check.
new_findings.affects: Dyslexic learners who encode the last form they see

new_findings.title: Capital-letter task shows its answers in small letters
new_findings.problem: The 'Capital (A)' bin shows israel, london, maya, i in lower case with green ticks; the answer line reads 'Capital (A): i, maya, london, israel'.
new_findings.suggestion: After the check, render Capital-bin items capitalised (israel → Israel) in the bin and in the answer line.

new_findings.title: Picture game still deducts 3 points per wrong pair in calm mode
new_findings.problem: A wrong pair shows red '(פחות 3 נקודות)', and the result reads '12 × 10 − 1 × 3 = 117'. The other games dropped penalties in calm mode.
new_findings.evidence: 51-pic-wrong.png; results text in the s09-pics run
new_findings.suggestion: No deduction in calm mode; keep 'נסו שוב' and report accuracy separately.

new_findings.title: Self-corrected answers are listed as plain mistakes on the end screen
new_findings.problem: After fixing e9 on the second try ('נכון'), the summary still shows 'כתבתם: ~~xx~~ → We live in Jerusalem…' styled like an unfixed error.
new_findings.suggestion: Label these 'תיקנתם בעצמכם' in a neutral style.
new_findings.affects: All learners; motivation of struggling learners

new_findings.title: The 12-card memory board runs below the screen at 150%
new_findings.problem: The grid starts at y=472 and is 460px tall; the last row is below the 844px viewport, with an empty band above the grid. Scrolling breaks the spatial memory the game needs.
new_findings.suggestion: Default to the 8-card board at 130%+, and remove the reserved empty band.

new_findings.title: Learn steps are still several screens each at 150%, and the reading time never changes
new_findings.problem: 8 steps of 1,014-2,156px at 150%; pa1-01 and a1-01 both say 'כ-5 דק׳ קריאה'.
new_findings.evidence: 22-a1-learn-150-step0..7.png; step heights logged in the s04-a1 run
new_findings.suggestion: Cap each step at about one screen at the chosen text size, fold extra examples, and compute the reading time per lesson.

new_findings.title: Word quiz feedback is harsher than lessons, and keycaps show on touch
new_findings.problem: A red box titled 'לא נכון' (lessons say 'לא בדיוק'), and option keycaps 1-4 visible on a touch phone.
new_findings.suggestion: Use 'לא בדיוק' with a neutral border, and hide keycaps on touch.

new_findings.title: 'תחזור בעוד דקה' repeated under every missed word
new_findings.problem: Seven identical 'תחזור בעוד דקה' labels; ambiguous, and they read like a wait instruction.
new_findings.suggestion: One line above the list ('המילים האלה יחזרו עוד היום').
